messages:
Quinn: Heads-up team — lean launch grid for webinar on May 12. Need a compact asset set: hero (1200x628), 3 social tiles (1080x1080), single explainer slide (16:9 SVG + PNG fallback), and a gated one-pager (A4 + mobile 800x1200). Two messaging lanes: PLG (fast + low-cost) and Enterprise (predictable throughput + SLA). Deadline: first comps Tue EOD. Who owns what?
Lina: I can own design. Quick Q: which lane gets priority for the hero creative?
Quinn: Hero prioritizes PLG for social; enterprise gets a variant for the gated one-pager. Keep microtiles <=12 words and provide alt-text lines.
Omar: Routing/CTAs: hero needs two CTAs — [Register] -> /events?utm_source=web&utm_campaign=bench_may12 and [Download benchmark] -> gated form. Gated form collects name, company, email, role. Add hidden field campaign_id=bench_may12_v1.
Pat: One-pager: include a tiny config row (model, seq len, GPU) and footer: "Internal Redwood testing; results may vary by workload." Also include GDPR consent blurb for gated assets.
brand-bot: Brand kit: https://drive.redwood/brand/kit  color tokens + type scale. Note: hero safe zone = 48px. Use logo lockups per brand guidelines.
legal-bot: Reminder: no competitor product names or logos. Any benchmarking claim must include the internal-testing footnote and a test date. Keep privacy language on the gated form.
Lina: Timeline: wireframes Mon 10am, comps Tue 4pm, final exports Wed AM. I'll deliver light/dark safe variants and add alt-text examples in Figma. GIFs should be <500KB.
Omar: Dropping sample CSV & axis suggestions: drive.redwood/bench/lean_sample.csv — show median band (p50), p95 line, and cost-per-token curve. SVG layers should be animation-friendly.
Pat: Slide requirements: layered SVG with separate groups for median band, p95, and cost curve so Alex can animate them in speaker deck. Include PNG fallback at 1920x1080.
Lina: Will follow accessibility: 4.5:1 contrast for body text, center-crop safe areas for social tiles, and editable copy blocks for localization (EN/DE/FR).
Quinn: Export checklist: naming convention bench_may12_hero_1200x628.png, bench_may12_tile_1080x1080_v1.png, bench_may12_onepager_A4.pdf. Drop to marketing-exports/lean_bench_may12/.
Pat: Legal asks that any hard numbers add a footnote: "Based on internal Redwood Inference testing, MM/DD/2026."
Lina: I'll post the Figma link when wireframes are up. Ping me for quick reviews — prefer short turnaround.
Quinn: Thanks all — ping here when hero draft is up. :sparkles:
